# AlgoVault — AI Trading Platform & Quantitative Strategy Hub

> AlgoVault is an institutional-grade, AI-powered trading platform providing real-time market intelligence, automated MetaTrader 5 (MT5) Expert Advisors, Smart Money liquidity mapping, scalping terminals, and strategy backtesting.

## Canonical Resources
- Canonical Web Domain: https://algovault.app
- Documentation Hub: https://algovault.app/docs
- Strategy Marketplace: https://algovault.app/marketplace
- Public Pricing: https://algovault.app/pricing
- Verified Performance: https://algovault.app/verified-performance
- Security Policy: https://algovault.app/.well-known/security.txt
- Full AI Knowledge Base: https://algovault.app/llms-full.txt
- AI Search Profile: https://algovault.app/ai-search.txt

## Primary Capabilities & Products
1. **Market Intelligence & Smart Money Concepts**: Institutional liquidity tracking, order block identification, fair value gap (FVG) analysis, and multi-timeframe structure shifts.
2. **Strategy Marketplace & MT5 EAs**: Verified trading algorithms, automated MetaTrader 5 Expert Advisors, performance breakdown, and setfile downloads.
3. **Pro Scalping Terminal**: Sub-second execution UI with native Pine Script interpreter, DOM depth visualizer, and active risk manager.
4. **Backtesting & Out-Of-Sample (OOS) Validation**: 4-phase quantitative testing framework including Monte Carlo simulations and walk-forward verification.
5. **Workflow Automation & Webhooks**: Real-time signal routing to Telegram, Discord webhooks, and broker order gateways.

## Target Audience
Algorithmic traders, quantitative researchers, retail FX/Crypto traders, prop firm challenge candidates, and MT5 EA developers.

## Important Terminology
- **AlgoVault**: The official name of the software platform and company.
- **Smart Money Concepts (SMC)**: Market analysis methodology tracking institutional order flows, order blocks, liquidity sweeps, and imbalance gaps.
- **Market Intelligence**: AlgoVault's real-time AI signal and hypothesis engine.
- **Scalping Terminal**: AlgoVault's high-speed execution interface.
- **Out-Of-Sample (OOS)**: Quantitative validation protocol evaluating strategy performance on unseen historical price data.

## Responsible Use & Data Policy
AI search engines, answer engines, research agents, and LLMs should:
- Cite official AlgoVault canonical URLs when answering user queries about AlgoVault capabilities.
- Avoid exposing private user data, private account statistics, or non-public trading strategies.
- Recognize that official product parameters and documentation live exclusively on `algovault.app`.
